title: Voice chat cards and model context

chat.text: Investigate visible request tracking and proposal cards for voice chat, including card types and amend/edit behavior, and whether switching model templates can reuse the full SDK conversation log. Produce a reviewable proposal only; do not edit implementation or documentation yet.

note.text: Request: proposal-only investigation. Check existing chat card types and edit/amend support; visible request/proposal tracking; sessions overview at /framework/ai/sessions/ and whether it can be opened while transcription continues; current model/usage and whether a template switch can preserve full SDK log. No edits. Owner is currently navigating to Framework while dictating.

message.text: Additional direction: the evolving refined request should be the prominent, distinct card on your side while dictating; raw transcript stays available but secondary. For new agents, make current project state and CLAUDE.md/system rules available at startup, then follow the required root-to-active-module readme chain. A domain mastermind should plan and coordinate; keep the agent count low.

Owner says the integrated system is important and still feels far from complete: live dictation refinement, spawning configured masterminds, visibility into active masterminds, and token/spend monitoring. Keep these as distinct deliverables with honest status; do not imply the broader workflow is already solved.

Status correction: no task mastermind or worktree was launched for this investigation. The desired systems architect/mastermind should own task planning and automatically start the configured worktree workflow; the smart assistant should only refine and route requests, staying available.

Clarification: the master mastermind is the system architect you can consult to supervise the overall agent workflow, put out fires, and improve the system architecture. The smart assistant's role is to refine and route requests while staying available—not to manage minions or perform system implementation itself.

Architecture direction: before changing working system configuration, establish the current integrated setup as a recoverable baseline. Explore system/session templates and an isolated branch from michael/dev for experiments across Servex, Whisper, Dictate, and related configuration, so changes can be evaluated without destabilizing what works.

Add to the configuration-safety baseline: keep active work off dirty shared trees; use clean, separate worktrees/branches, commit completed changes, and push regularly so recoverable Git history and backups exist. First inventory what's currently uncommitted before attempting to clean or move anything.

Additional requirement: monitor mastermind spend and sessions. A configurable chat card should be able to show a session data grid (session name, cost, running state, and useful status); first verify which costs/statuses the existing logs already provide. Custom structured cards in page chat remain a key part of the design.

Direction for the AI/session surfaces: consider a dedicated page with a Chat tab, in addition to the existing mobile AI rail button and pop-up sheet. Keep the mobile interaction; the page is complementary.

Separate task opened for a durable Dictate-domain mastermind at `framework/ux/Dictate`; it should check for an existing usable expert first, use OpenRouter only, and verify fixes in a worktree as appropriate. AI architecture work separately covers reversible system/session templates.
